compute_nist_mt_score: compute NIST MT score for machine translation predictions against references
load_nist_mt_metric: load the NIST MT metric via evaluate.load for scoring translation hypotheses
tokenize_with_nist: tokenize prediction and reference text using NLTK's NIST-specific tokenizer
score_single_reference: score predictions against a single reference per prediction
score_multiple_references: score predictions against multiple references per prediction
